evidence: We offer free weekly practice groups for LGBTQIA+ individuals, BIPOC communities, and people with disabilities, grounded in the belief that healing and liberation are interconnected.
You are welcome here whether you're single, married, LGBTQ+, or part of any other community.
Founded by Nolan Wood, the shop emphasizes community support, LGBTQ+ inclusion, and sustainable sourcing.
Our community welcomes all—regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, or life stage.
